question.text: A natural number has prime factorization given by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi></msup><msup><mn>3</mn><mi>y</mi></msup><msup><mn>5</mn><mi>z</mi></msup></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>z</mi></math> are such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>z</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>y</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>z</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>5</mn><mn>6</mn></mfrac><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>></mo><mi>z</mi></math>. Then the number of odd divisors of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math>, including <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn></math>, is:<gwmw style="display:none;"></gwmw>

solution.text:
y+z=5

1y+1z=56  y>z

⇒y=3,z=2

⇒n=2x.33.52=2.2.2…3.3.35.5

For calculating the odd divisor ofn=2x3y5z, x must be 0.

Hence, Number of odd divisors =3+1×2+1=4×3=12.
